'''Willim''' may refer to:
*[[Willim]], [[Da'shain Aiel]] brother of [[Rand al'Thor]]'s ancestor [[Adan]].
*[[Willim al'Dai]], former member of the [[Emond's Field]] [[Village Council]].
*[[Willim Avarhin]], [[Andoran]] [[nobleman]] and father of [[Shiaine Avarhin]] whose identity [[Mili Skane]] stole.
*[[Willim of Maneches]], famous essayist. See ''[[The Essays of Willim of Maneches]]''.
